{{Short description|Algebraic correspondence}}
{{orphan|date=August 2017}}
{{one source |date=May 2024}}
In [[algebra]], a '''normal homomorphism''' is a [[ring homomorphism]] <math>R \to S</math> that is [[flat module|flat]] and is such that for every field extension ''L'' of the [[residue field]] <math>\kappa(\mathfrak{p})</math> of any [[prime ideal]] <math>\mathfrak{p}</math>, <math>L \otimes_R S</math> is a [[normal ring]].
